name: Sarvam: Saaras V3
description:
Saaras V3 is Sarvam AI's next-generation automatic speech recognition (ASR) model engineered for Indian languages and real-world speech conditions.
Saaras V3 supports 23 languages (22 official Indian languages plus English) within a unified multilingual model. The model achieves approximately 19% Word Error Rate (WER) on the IndicVoices benchmark, improving significantly from its predecessor Saaras V2.5 which had ~22% WER. On the 10 most popular languages in the IndicVoices dataset, it achieves 19.3% WER, and performance advantages widen for lower-resource Indian languages
